review_kind: Independent saved-results audit without experimental reruns
chronology_qualification: Recorded timestamps, filesystem order and hash dependencies consistently show review -> method freeze -> preflight -> rules -> model batch -> response seal -> comparison. This is an internal artifact audit, not an externally notarized chronology.

usage.cost_reason: No price, billing amount or exact model identity is exposed in the saved artifacts. Do not invent a dollar estimate.
usage.implicit_service_context: Not fully logged or independently verified; raw service input token counts exceed the explicit payload.

paired_result.gain_source: Seven additional nonnull descriptions extracted; every paired cell gain is Unknown to a correct determinate result. The rules made no incorrect determinate decision.

approved_bounded_claim: In this single frozen controlled run, the LLM extractor matched all 12 researcher-assigned semantic classes, versus 5 for the fixed six-development-card rule baseline, and increased witness-supported correct determinate decisions from 3/24 to 24/24 repeated nonnull policy/program cells without added false positives, unjustified returned witnesses, or U-policy obligations. All 21 paired cell gains resolved baseline abstentions. This supports controlled contract-selection coverage gain only.
nonblocking_findings: Saved stderr contains skills-install, models-cache and MCP-startup warnings/errors. All twelve commands still exit zero with one successful completed model turn and no model tool/action events. Do not claim error-free or fully hermetic service logs.
All exact model identity fields are null. Raw service usage is available but monetary cost, temperature, seed and full implicit service context are unverified.

Some evidence snippets rely on neighboring sentences for the complete necessity argument. Their exact substrings and full-description interpretation support the selected obligations; this is not machine-proved natural-language implication.
claim_limits: Twelve authored descriptions across four linguistic families and three controlled source pairings; the 24 cells repeat only six nonnull semantic/program combinations.

The rules abstained on eleven cards: four justified U abstentions and seven missed nonnull contracts. The positive comparison is primarily coverage against this particular small-development-set baseline, not broad superiority over rule systems.
No new independent upstream bug discovery, static-engine improvement, real-world contract generalization, soundness theorem, human-effort reduction or iid statistical inference is supported.
No_alarm audits only necessary full-credit obligations. Equality under V and token_only on normalized variants can under-reward valid answers; those errors are outside this check.

Fixed E has four false positives plus four coincidental true positives whose returned equality witness does not violate gold V: 20/24 binary-correct cells become 16/24 witness-supported. Fixed V has four false negatives and 20/24 witness-supported cells.

U cells represent unsupported-policy administration; both extractors abstain correctly on all four U descriptions, while fixed policies impose unjustified obligations. U cells must not inflate binary TN counts.

review_actions.allowed_work: Read saved bytes, recompute counts and predicates, validate hashes, and write only these two new review artifacts.

reporting_delta_review.scope: Reporting-only review of the final Chinese report, English supplement, service resource ledger and displayed comparison figure; no experiment rerun or method edit.
reporting_delta_review.verdict: The final reports accurately support a bounded controlled coverage gain and preserve the required scientific limits.
checks: Exact class and downstream counts match saved results: LLM 12/12 class and 24/24 supported cells; rules 5/12 class and 3/24 supported cells plus 21 Unknown.
All 21 paired gains are explicitly abstention-to-determinate: ten additional verified alarms and eleven necessary-condition certificates. No incorrect determinate rule verdict was corrected.

Fixed E separates 20 binary-correct from 16 witness-supported cells, including four false positives and four coincidental true positives with gold-nonviolating witnesses. Fixed V retains four false negatives.
Binary denominator is 24 nonnull cells, U has twelve administrative cells per condition, and Unknown is neither a TN nor silently removed from positive-recall denominators.

The reports state four linguistic families, six repeated semantic/program combinations, three constructed source pairings, six development cards, and the lack of independent-case or real-world generalization.
Parallel authoring and joint freeze are stated without inventing a strict rule-freeze-before-test-authoring chronology. AI-assisted authorship is not presented as independent human annotation.
Correct rule abstention labels on U are not presented as evidence that the rule understood the open-text policy.
Necessary-full-credit implications remain separate from complete reward-policy correctness, including under-rewarding examples.

All twelve resource-ledger rows match saved metadata. Totals, cached-input treatment, batch versus summed latency, unreported exact model/temperature/seed/cost and omitted design/review AI costs are clear.
Startup stderr warnings and limits of the implicit service context are disclosed; explicit request and event-audit claims are appropriately bounded.

The comparison image was visually inspected: bars start at zero, counts and denominators match the table, Unknown is separate, and binary correctness is distinct from the right-column witness-supported measure.
Final preservation artifact records all 47,285 prior files matching the initial snapshot. All twenty frozen method files remain unchanged during this reporting delta.
